latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of youtube-watcher skill.
- Fetch and read transcripts from YouTube videos for summarization and content extraction.
- Includes access to 50+ models for image/video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS through SkillBoss API.
- Requires a SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for authentication.
